tools.name: list_diseases
tools.title: List crop diseases
tools.description: Return the full CropGuard almanac of crop diseases with symptoms, treatment, prevention, and severity.

crop.description: Optional case-insensitive substring filter matched against the disease's crop field.

tools.name: search_diseases_by_symptoms
tools.title: Diagnose by symptoms
tools.description: Given a list of observed symptoms, return likely crop diseases ranked by how many symptoms match. Use one or more of the supported symptom labels.

symptoms.description: List of observed symptoms. Supported labels: Yellow leaves, Brown spots on leaves, Wilting, White powdery coating, Black spots, Curling leaves, Stunted growth, Root rot, Fruit discoloration, Stem lesions, Leaf holes, Mold growth. Free-form text is matched case-insensitively.

tools.name: get_my_profile
tools.title: Get my CropGuard profile
tools.description: Return the signed-in user's CropGuard profile, including email, full name, login count, and subscription status.
